what.text: This page follows refugees from Mauritania living in Mali, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 15044 Mauritanian refugees in Mali, 34.3% of all refugees from Mauritania.
Senegal hosts the most Mauritanian refugees, followed by Mali, France and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict in Mauritania in most of the main years of displacement, so it does not say why people left.
UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mauritania with AQIM in 2010 only.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 13000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 16997, at the end of 1995.
It fell to a low in 1999 and then rose again; the main years of displacement in the data include 1990 to 1992, 1995 to 1998 and 2009 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mali.
These are year-end totals for Mali only, reported to UNHCR.
